# DREAM Lab Cloud Services

Cloud computing services for research and teaching at UC Santa Barbara. Managed by the [UCSB Library DREAM Lab](https://www.library.ucsb.edu/dreamlab) using computing resources provided by the [College of Letters and Science IT (LSIT)](https://www.lsit.ucsb.edu).

[Launch a Workspace ↗](https://coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu){.btn-gold target="_blank"} &nbsp;
[Getting Started Guide](guides/getting-started.qmd){.btn-navy}
:::

## What we offer

Flexible tools supported by people who understand research, teaching, and creative practice.

::: {.grid-cards}

::: {.custom-card}
### Coder Workspaces
On-demand virtual machines with commonly used data science tools pre-installed. Anyone with a UCSB NetID can create a workspace for the duration of the academic quarter.

[Explore Coder Workspaces →](coder-workspaces.qmd)
:::

::: {.custom-card .custom-card--gateway}
<span class="tag">Experimental</span>

### AI Gateway
API access to Large Language Models (LLMs) hosted by campus cloud providers through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for coding agents and research workflows.

[Learn about the AI Gateway →](ai-gateway.qmd)
:::

:::

## Getting started in 3 steps

[Read the full guide →](guides/getting-started.qmd)

::: {.step-item}
::: {.step-badge}
01
:::
::: {.step-content}
### Log in with your UCSB NetID
Visit **[coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu](https://coder.dreamlab.ucsb.edu)** and log in securely using UCSB Single Sign-On via Google.
:::
:::

::: {.step-item}
::: {.step-badge}
02
:::
::: {.step-content}
### Create a workspace
Choose a name, accept usage policies, and enable optional tools like RStudio, JupyterLab, or VS Code.
:::
:::

::: {.step-item}
::: {.step-badge}
03
:::
::: {.step-content}
### Open in browser or local IDE
Work in your browser via VS Code Web, RStudio, or Terminal, or connect directly from desktop VS Code or SSH.
:::
:::

## Need help?

Find answers in our documentation or talk through your project with a DREAM Lab specialist.

- **[UCSB Carpentry Slack ↗](https://join.slack.com/t/ucsbcarpentry/shared_invite/zt-3chxqtb2b-cVc3l~yj1ghUhZLNmOLfhQ)** — Ask questions in real time with our campus community.
- **Email us:** [dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu](mailto:dreamlab@library.ucsb.edu) — Email our team directly for consultations.
